cost_evidence.host_binding: base_ssh_captures list: each {config_sha256,gpu_uuid,ssh_alias,source:{path,sha256}} binds a BASE completed configuration to original external SSH capture bytes containing that exact config hash and GPU UUID. UUID must match both successful before/after snapshots in every committed A2 sample. A self-written host_id map is rejected; this checks supplied evidence consistency, not cryptographic host attestation.
cost_evidence.identity: A2_SOURCE plus frozen original checkpoint and achievable prior hash; complete profile manifest commits all samples
cost_evidence.scope: 1.1 times measured A2 mean is provisional engineering screen, never formal COST02 acceptance. Current A2 profile provenance uses its real GPU UUID, without inventing historical hostname fields. Original A2 equivalence remains the separately archived COST-01 audit; this selector does not rerun or broaden that audit. Old Bstar cost ratio unavailable unless separately measured.

protocol.integrity: Exclusive output; verify batch/config/record/raw SHA256, exact 192x40 coverage, same exogenous input hashes, raw error counts, explicit qualifications, uniform source/checkpoint/code/protocol. Sum of bound BASE batch reservations cannot exceed7680F. Terminal support/gains/positive variances validated. Selection protocol binds current selector and baseline-design SHA256.

interval.family: all 40 choose 2 comparisons, fixed before selection
interval.method: paired_delta exact binomial marginal CP union bound

protocol.qualification: All 192 blocks for every 40 recipes required. Any false baseline_eligible excludes that recipe from qualification but retains full denominator and qualification failure rate. Any missing/failed execution prevents selection.
selection: Within each family: qualified and provisional cost-screened configurations ordered by FER, mean full-call seconds, recipe ID.
First reference: family representatives ordered by FER, mean full-call seconds, recipe ID.
Other-family representative is demonstrably worse only when simultaneous lower bound of FER_candidate - FER_first exceeds zero.
Among remaining other-family representatives prefer cost/FER Pareto nondominated representatives, then FER, cost, ID. Keep at most one additional reference.
If no qualified cost-screened reference exists: explicit failure; never relax thresholds. Unselected indistinguishable references are not claimed defeated.
